review_scope: Technical comparison of 23 paired composed physical views after backing the 4B bath curtain recess. The bath, adjoining studio, independent grille, curtain drag and isolated legacy-record reload are exercised in separate receipts.

images.observation: The boiler case, gauge, pipes and underside occupy the same positions under comparable light.
The case, doorway and window-side table retain their prior placement and finishes.
The tiled joints, cistern and vent-surround edge remain continuous.
The sampled shaft wall retains the same dark brick finish. The carriage is outside the view.
Table, receiver, rug and surrounding trim remain visible through small companion animation differences.
The shower curtain and tiles retain coverage around the lamp spot.
The room's exterior window and radiator retain their profile. The resident and companion sit at different animation frames.
The neighboring flat's visible exterior window, shelving and floor retain the same arrangement. The separate survey covers its solid west wall.
Upper cabinets, sink and floor still frame the illuminated wall and companion.
The open leaf, fuse positions and cable run remain legible. The candidate has a darker leaf reflection.
The dark floor, brass strip and foreground edges keep the same coverage.
Portrait, cat and shelf retain the same positions and low-light rendering.
Overhead supports, wall shelves and the warm light at the right retain the same composition.
Mailboxes, low paneling and bench retain their geometry under the dark lighting sample.
Radiator, neighboring curtain and table props retain their framing and surface detail.
Landing geometry, rail and exposed ceiling lights retain placement with small shadow differences.
Tank silhouette, ladder and rail remain intact against the same skyline profile.
The terminal's illuminated controls, board and table remain visible.
The cistern fittings and adjoining tile courses retain alignment through the shadow shift.
The residue and the radiator behind it remain legible. The companion's position varies slightly.
The installed strands retain their visible grain and placement. The companion and shadows vary slightly.
The mapped counter, crumbs and toaster remain visible. Background motes vary between frames.
The wall-mounted watch box and mapped plaster retain their outline and contrast.
